components.doc: Text for screen readers only (the sentence under a chart that only has marks).
The sticky see-through header bar (.top-in holds its row: brand, menu, tools).
The logo and the app's name; on phones only the logo stays.
The page menu: pills that scroll sideways; the current page (aria-current) is an inverted pill.
The page menu beside the page: a left sidebar from 900px (232px; html.side-folded narrows it to a 64px icon rail), below that a bottom tab bar under a row with the brand and the tools.
A 30px outlined pill button (language, light / dark); a row of them sits in .tools.
An uppercase pill in the watch colours that says the numbers are made up.
The page title row: h1, a .sub line under it, a stepper on the right.
Earlier / later pills; a span with aria-disabled="true" is a step that is not there.
A 12-column grid with .span-12 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5 / 4; at 1080px and narrower every span is full width.
Stacks cards inside one grid column, so no card stretches over empty space.
The surface for one topic; its h2 (or a .section-title) is a small label row with an .aside on the right.
Text: .lede is the verdict sentence; .muted, .small, .xs and .num (tabular figures) go anywhere.
Layout helpers: .stack is a column, .row a wrapping row, .spacer pushes what follows to the end.
A small uppercase label above a verdict.
The one big number on a card.
A 24px state pill: plain = neutral, .good / .bad / .watch for a state (always with its word), .accent to point out.
An 8px round colour swatch, coloured inline.
A wrapping row of .key items; .key i is a 10px swatch coloured inline, .key i.hatch the stripes of a lanes() hatch part in its color (ink unless set) (legendKey() draws mark-shaped keys).
The box for dayRing(): square, 360px at most, centred over its legend in a .ring-wrap.
A list with a time column: li holds .when, .what (b + a .muted line) and an optional chip.
A row of three small stats: each div holds a span label over a big b value.
A grid of metric tiles; a .tile holds .label (name + chip), .value, a chart slot and .note. .tiles.two = two columns, .tiles.aligned = five shared rows.
A segmented switch: buttons on a track, the chosen one (aria-pressed="true") raised.
A small switch between pages that share a menu item; use it as class="subnav seg" with links.
The "How this is worked out" fold: details.how with a summary and short paragraphs.
A dashed box that says there is nothing to show yet.
The quiet row at the end of a page.
The one tooltip of the page (installTooltip()); any element with data-tip shows it.
Shares of a whole as one bar: a span per part, sized with flex and coloured inline.
A thin bar for one amount: the inner span sets its width and colour inline.
How far along a plan is, in the accent colour: the inner span sets the width.
A round check mark: .good (✓), .bad (✗), plain for unknown (–).
Label and value rows (a dl of divs, each with dt and dd), split by hairlines.
Tables split by hairlines, in a .table-wrap that scrolls sideways; table.sectioned tr.sec is a section heading row.
Monospace: inline code, and .code for a block.
The box a chart from charts.js is drawn into (draw()); its svg is a block that never overflows.
A phrase that stays on one line, so Chinese text breaks between phrases before it breaks inside one.

charts.name: esc
charts.doc: Escapes text for HTML and SVG attributes and content.

charts.name: CHART_WORDS
charts.doc: The words the charts write, with their English defaults; an app's own t() gets the same keys.

charts.name: setFormat
charts.doc: Hands the kit an app's words and formats: any of t, dur, clock, shortDay, measure, toDate, wtype; a word t() lacks falls back to CHART_WORDS.

charts.name: formatDuration
charts.doc: Minutes written as a duration by the dur() handed to setFormat() ("7h 54m" by default); stackedColumns and lanes write their values with it.

charts.name: toneColor
charts.doc: The colour of a mark for a tone: "good" = --good, "bad" = --off, anything else = the neutral --c-mark.

charts.name: draw
charts.doc: Draws fn(width) into el at its real pixel width and again whenever the box is resized.

charts.name: installTooltip
charts.doc: Adds the page's one tooltip (.tip): any element with data-tip shows it on hover and on keyboard focus.

charts.name: niceStep
charts.doc: A round axis step (1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten) that splits span into about count parts.

charts.name: spark
charts.signature: spark(series, band, { width, height = 46, unit = "", tone = "neutral" })
charts.doc: 14 days as a line over the "your normal" band; × marks a day without a record, the end dot takes the tone.

charts.name: bullet
charts.signature: bullet(value, band, { width, unit = "", tone = "neutral", height = 18 })
charts.doc: One value against its band on a line: band = normal, tick = its median, dot = the value in its tone.

charts.name: rangeStrip
charts.doc: One value on its own scale: band = normal (q1–q3), tick = median, dot = the value, dashed tick = a plan or limit.

charts.name: trendLine
charts.doc: A short line through a few averages (eight weeks, say) with an end dot; missing points are bridged; needs two.

charts.name: legendKey
charts.doc: A legend key drawn the way its mark is drawn: "normal" (band), "median", "now" (dot), "plan" (dashed tick), "weeks" (trend).

charts.name: RING_CATS
charts.doc: The screen groups of the ring, inside out: [key, the categories it adds up, colour].

charts.name: dayRing
charts.signature: dayRing(ring, { size = 360, center = "", centerSub = "", cats = RING_CATS })
charts.doc: A 24-hour clock, midnight at the top: sleep outside, workouts and (faint, as context) the calendar in the middle, screen minutes per hour inside.

charts.name: interval
charts.signature: interval(row, domain, { width, height = 26, flip = false })
charts.doc: A difference with its 95% interval against a zero line; right = a better next day (flip mirrors it).

charts.name: dayDots
charts.doc: One circle per day: filled = done, hollow = 0, dashed = no record; the day of the month under each.

charts.name: timeChart
charts.signature: timeChart(layers, { width, height = 240, first, last, unit = "", fmt = (v) => String(v), yPad = 0.15, maxGap = 7 })
charts.doc: A date axis with a shaded corridor, faint daily points, a line that breaks after maxGap days and dashed reference lines.

charts.name: stackedColumns
charts.signature: stackedColumns(columns, groups, { width, height = 200, limit = null, limitLabel = "", maxValue = null, labelEvery = 1, unitFmt = formatDuration, minutes = true })
charts.doc: Columns of stacked categories on one scale (minutes tick on round hours), with an optional dashed limit named in a key under the axis; × = no record.

charts.name: blockColumns
charts.signature: blockColumns(columns, { width, height = 210, minTop = 60, label = "", maxChars = 12 })
charts.doc: Columns of stacked blocks, one per item (block height = its value), a total above each column and two label lines under it.

charts.name: sleepWindows
charts.doc: One bar per night on a 20:00–14:00 axis, the alarm as an ink tick over it, an optional dashed target window.

charts.name: ladderChart
charts.doc: The alarm as a step line (earlier = higher) with wake dots, green on time and red late, and the goal dashed.

charts.name: coverage
charts.doc: One cell per day from first: "1" = has data, "p" = partial, anything else = nothing.

charts.name: lanes
charts.signature: lanes(rows, cols, { width, rowH = 46, gap = 10, labelW = 150, labelEvery = 1, unitFmt = formatDuration, showMax = true })
charts.doc: One row per activity with columns over hours or days, each row on its own scale; × = no record, dashed = a limit, stripes = a hatch part.

charts.name: mealTimeline
charts.doc: One row per day on a 05:00–03:00 axis: awake from waking to falling asleep (sleep in violet at both ends), meals as dots sized by energy, the gapH hours before sleep striped; a meal inside them is ringed and its tooltip says how long before sleep it was. A day with status "none" is written as not logged; "partial" draws its meals faint.

charts.name: keptDots
charts.doc: A run of days as dots, a small gap after every 7th: filled = the goal was kept, a ring = not kept, a short dash = no record that day.

charts.name: ICON_KEYS
charts.doc: The names icon() knows, in drawing order.

charts.name: icon
charts.doc: The icon for key at size px (an unknown key draws the dashed clock of "not recorded").

charts.name: COLOR
charts.doc: The colour each icon is drawn in: its data colour (ai, the AI assistant: focus blue), ink-3 for not recorded, ink-2 for the check, food (no data colour of its own) and the two devices-at-once measures; the menu glyphs take the text colour.

charts.name: STATE_ICON
charts.doc: The 12px glyphs inside a state chip: good = a tick, bad = an exclamation mark.
